Nobody on the andr36oid team has tested:
Nobody on the andr36oid team has tested this device tree on real hardware. It can leave the screen black or the buttons dead, and in the worst case put a wrong voltage on part of the board.

Support for experimental device trees is very limited. If something doesn't work:
- Report it only in the clone issue tracker: %s
- Attach all the boot files from a system that works on your console, for example from the SD card it came with: every .dtb file and the other files at the top of its first drive.
- Answer every question in the issue form.

Closing the flasher now would leave the: Closing the flasher now would leave the card half-written, and it would not start in a console. Wait until writing is finished. To end it early, choose Stop first: the flasher then finishes the block in progress and says what the card is like.
As in the image (recommended): puts back: As in the image (recommended): puts back the bootloader that the chosen image file carries. Needs no internet.

A bootloader change replaces U-Boot only: A bootloader change replaces U-Boot only. The first start-up stage stays as it is, and games, saves and apps are not touched. With an image file chosen, its first start-up stage and sleep firmware are put back as well, the same way an update does.
Done. The card has the new bootloader. P: Done. The card has the new bootloader. Put the card back in the console and switch it on. If it doesn't start, come back here and choose "As in the image".
